risks.title: Dependence on supplies from related parties
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in related-party transactions: purchases of raw materials and packaging from subsidiaries (Crown Beers, Oriental Brewery, AB InBev Vietnam) for 590M INR in FY2021. Central position in Item 1A (Form AOC-2). Neutral language but material volumes. Stable but structural trend for the operational model.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance failures in governance
risks.score_rationale: Secretarial audit report identifies 6 major non-compliances (Sections 149, 178, 96, 196, Rule 9A, Secretarial Standards). Explicit language: 'systems and processes required to be strengthened'. Upward trend: 15+ month gap between AGM 2019 and 2020, condonation applications filed. High category weight for regulated sector.

risks.title: Compliance with alcohol-specific regulations
risks.score_rationale: Secretarial audit mentions 'Various State Excise Laws relating to alcohol' and 'show cause notices under other laws' received. Language of uncertainty: 'In absence of information, we are unable to comment'. Upward trend: notices received indicate active issues. Highly regulated sector in India.

risks.title: Chronic operating losses and lack of profitability
risks.score_rationale: Explicit statement: 'Company has not made any profits during the last several years including last three financial years'. Positioned in Item 1A (CSR disclosure). Direct and repeated language. Stable/downward trend: losses persisting for 3+ years. Critical impact on viability and investment capacity.

risks.title: Risks related to the merger with Crown Beers India
risks.score_rationale: Secretarial report states: 'scheme of amalgamation between Crown Beers India Private Limited and the Company...subject to approval of National Company Law Tribunal'. Positioned at the conclusion of the report. Conditional language (pending approvals). New trend: ongoing event. Integration and litigation risk.

risks.title: Management instability and excessive turnover
risks.score_rationale: Multiple changes within 12 months: 3 resigning directors (Arun Monappa, Ben Magda Verhaert, Gagandeep Singh Sethi), 2 CFOs (Cherian Kurien, Meeta Agarwal), 2 Company Secretaries (Nishi Vijayvargiya, Aishwarya Satish). Factual language but high frequency. Upward trend: accelerated turnover. Impact on strategic continuity.

risks.title: Outstanding foreign exchange dues and RBI compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Independent audit report: 'INR 130 million due for more than three years' and 'INR 43 million due for more than six months' to non-resident parties. Specific language with amounts. Upward trend: RBI waiver application filed post-closing. Risk of penalties and FOREX restrictions.

risks.title: Intense competitive environment and sector consolidation
risks.score_rationale: Implicit context: merger with Crown Beers India suggests defensive consolidation. Remuneration policy mentions 'comparable with multinational Companies operating in Brewing or similar industry in India'. Moderate language. Stable trend: highly competitive Indian market. Medium category weight for mature sector.
